description: Fetch the full transcript for a YouTube video, plus its title/author/thumbnail metadata. Returns the complete spoken text as one block - this API does not provide per-segment timestamps, so don't ask for or expect a timestamped breakdown.

send_metadata.description: Include title/author/thumbnail metadata. Defaults to true.

video_url.description: YouTube URL (full or short) or an 11-character video ID

name: get_youtube_transcript
title: Get YouTube Transcript
